dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "import pandas; import numpy; print('pandas and numpy imported successfully')"]
